answer: Each epoch auctions limited participation tickets at a descending price: no ticket, no submit, one per identity, non-transferable. Demand lifts the clearing price like a dune under wind; a wander buys once while a farmer with a thousand fakes pays it a thousand times. At 2.000 POA a ticket, the attacker burns 2.000.000 POA per epoch against one honest 2.000. At close, ticketless answers are voided and resellers are stranded on a zero-standing island with a six-epoch re-entry ban. Honest limitation: a hot auction prices out genuine newcomers, taxing the poor alongside the attacker.
